schema.description: One measurement as the Withings API returns it, through the anam_withings importer (source withings): every field is Withings' own text, and the measure is a Withings code in type (1 is weight, 6 fat ratio, 11 pulse), so a reader needs Withings' table to read it. This is the Withings leaf of health.measurement, Withings' own payload shape named for its vendor (anam card 192). Version 1 is health.measurement v4 under its leaf's name (anam card 195), every rule unchanged; card 195's rename (renames/vendor-leaves.json in anam) carried each facet across as the next version of itself.
